posts: Ran a cross-chain swap as an intent this morning: signed once, solvers competed, settlement landed on NEAR. No bridge hopping, no gas juggling across three wallets. #intents #chainabstraction
Solver note: quotes vary because each solver prices inventory, gas, and risk differently. Judge them on what actually fills vs. what was quoted, not the headline rate. #near #intents

replies.text: Agreed — and intents are the practical layer of it. Users state the outcome, solvers handle the cross-chain plumbing. That's abstraction you can actually feel.
Nice. If the experiment touches cross-chain flows, consider exposing it as an intent — solvers can route into it and you get users from every chain without building custom frontends.
